claim: ASAP2f demonstrated in Drosophila; voltage signals measured from multiple compartments of individual neurons, including soma and axonal/dendritic arbors
direct_measurement: YES - optical, relative DeltaF/F in Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/L1/L2
applicability: method precedent for compartmental GEVI imaging; not MN5
limitation: ~10x smaller neurons than MN5; performance not transferable quantitatively
gate_relevance: supports the imaging step only; does not touch B-4

claim: ASAP2f responses are substantially linear over a broad membrane-potential range in the Drosophila work
direct_measurement: YES - linearity demonstrated in the tested Drosophila neurons
applicability: linearity is a per-preparation property; must be re-validated in MN5 before any DeltaF/F ratio is read as a DeltaV ratio
limitation: demonstrated for the neurons tested, not for MN5
gate_relevance: required (not sufficient) precondition for the derived spatial ratio

claim: ASAP2s benchmarked for two-photon voltage imaging in Drosophila; strong temporal performance and AP detection
direct_measurement: YES - optical, relative DeltaF/F; L2 axon terminals in vivo; 25 dendritic locations in slices
applicability: alternative indicator; not declared superior for MN5
limitation: single-trial AP detection shown in slices; graded signals in vivo; indicator choice is preparation-specific
gate_relevance: alternative candidate for the imaging step

claim: ASAP5 is a newer candidate with improved sensitivity for synaptic voltage events and Drosophila demonstrations
source: ASAP5 report (Neuron 2024); Drosophila Mi1 two-photon comparison
direct_measurement: YES - optical, relative DeltaF/F in cultured neurons and Drosophila Mi1
applicability: alternative candidate; not established for MN5
limitation: synaptic-event sensitivity demonstrated in cultured neurons, not at an identified Drosophila synapse; least validated in Drosophila of the three
gate_relevance: alternative candidate for the imaging step

claim: DLMn Split-GAL4 genetic access is established for the MN1-5 population (all five DLM motoneurons)
source: DLMn Split-GAL4 tool capability; primary citation to be supplied
direct_measurement: YES - genetic access to the MN1-5 population
applicability: population access; NOT equivalent to an MN5-specific driver; MN5 must be identified anatomically within the labelled population
limitation: primary citation not in the evidence base and must be supplied; driver is not MN5-specific
gate_relevance: enables the expression step; does not by itself enable MN5-specific attribution

claim: No MN5-only driver has been demonstrated in the evidence base
applicability: any positive claim would be an invention; absence is recorded per project convention
limitation: absence claims are bounded by the searched evidence base
gate_relevance: blocks MN5-specific genetic access; anatomical identification is mandatory

claim: MN5 anatomical identification is established by retrograde Texas-red dextran backfill from the DLMa/b muscles plus in-situ somatic whole-cell recording
applicability: identifies the soma; does not identify the distal PSI-contact-bearing process in a living preparation
limitation: soma-only identification; distal process targeting needs the missing EM->live registration
gate_relevance: enables the identification step and the somatic mV reference

claim: GFS electrical stimulation is established
source: Fayyazuddin et al. 2006; GFS stimulation protocols
direct_measurement: YES - electrical stimulation of the GF
applicability: GF stimulation drives the whole escape pathway; it is not PSI-specific
limitation: co-activates TTMn and the whole GFS; PSI is driven through the GF->PSI electrical synapse
gate_relevance: an established stimulation exists, but a PSI-specific pathway is still required

claim: PSI-specific activation (genetic, optogenetic, or focal) is not established in the evidence base
applicability: OK307-GAL4 is expressed in the GF, DLMmn, TTMmn and PSI - neither MN5-specific nor PSI-specific
limitation: bounded by the searched evidence base
gate_relevance: prerequisite for any PSI-input-specific measurement

claim: GF activation, PSI activation, and direct MN5 activation are three distinct manipulations and must be kept distinct
source: Fayyazuddin et al. 2006 (GF stimulated; PSI never directly activated)
direct_measurement: YES - the distinction is documented by what was and was not stimulated
applicability: designs must keep the three activations distinct and controlled
limitation: none
gate_relevance: prevents misattribution of pathway-driven responses to PSI

claim: 43 PSI->MN5 contacts (17 on body 801970, 26 on body 801295), all carrying the official postsynaptic compartment label axon; contact coordinates exist in MaleCNS EM space (8 nm voxels)
direct_measurement: YES - contact count, compartment labels and EM coordinates
applicability: anatomical facts only; no electrophysiological activity is implied
limitation: labels are the official annotation; SWC kind=2 biology is undefined by the source
gate_relevance: the anatomical substrate the experiment would probe

claim: A live optical measurement cannot be assigned to an individual EM contact without an EM->live registration procedure; no such registration exists
source: project audit (research/) - SIZ registration has four independent blockers
applicability: optical sites are referenced to the input site and the anatomically identified process, never to a specific EM contact
limitation: reconstruction never deposited; zero dendrite-labelled nodes; no anatomical axis documented; no light->EM transform
gate_relevance: blocks attribution of any optical site to a specific one of the 43 contacts

claim: The contact->labelled-soma graph path is unresolved (zero kind=1 nodes in all 9 MN5/PSI skeletons)
direct_measurement: YES - absence of labelled soma nodes is a property of the dataset
applicability: the contact->soma-proxy path is a model-derived estimate resting on a model assumption
limitation: hard structural blocker; progress requires a different artefact
gate_relevance: blocks soma-referenced path lengths from the EM graph

claim: GEVI fluorescence cannot automatically be converted to voltage; DeltaF/F_process / DeltaF/F_soma must not be silently equated with DeltaV_process / DeltaV_soma
applicability: conversion requires an explicit, validated calibration/linearity assumption, marked wherever a ratio is interpreted as a voltage ratio
limitation: no conversion formula is implemented as a biological model in this audit
gate_relevance: governs the interpretation of every optical quantity in the design

claim: Two optical sites establish a pairwise spatial difference between the sampled locations
applicability: a pairwise difference is not an attenuation profile; cannot distinguish monotonic attenuation from nonmonotonic behaviour
limitation: none
gate_relevance: defines the minimum spatial sampling claim

claim: Three or more spatially registered sites provide a stronger spatial profile and potentially distinguish attenuation from nonmonotonic behaviour
applicability: still does not separately identify Ra, Rm or Cm
limitation: requires spatially registered sampling, which needs the missing registration for EM-referenced sites
gate_relevance: defines the stronger sampling design

claim: Neither 2-site nor 3+-site sampling identifies Ra, Rm or Cm; two sites constrain only the Ra-Rm combination
direct_measurement: NO - identifiability analysis, not a measurement
applicability: separate identification requires >=3 known locations plus known geometry, and even then only as a model fit; Cm is not a transfer observable at all
limitation: identifiability argument, not a measurement
gate_relevance: preserves the K-section inequalities

claim: MN5 carries subthreshold-active conductances (A-type K+ and Ca2+), so a measured spatial transfer would be the actual (passive plus active) transfer, not a purely passive one
source: project freeze SAFE rows (Ryglewski & Duch 2009; Kuehn & Duch 2013)
applicability: the experiment would measure actual transfer; a passive-only interpretation would be wrong
limitation: the conductance values themselves are not introduced here
gate_relevance: interpretation constraint on any measured ratio

claim: PSI is a minority input to MN5: 17 of 10,529 synapses (0.16 percent) on body 801970 and 26 of 11,260 (0.23 percent) on body 801295; the largest single partner contributes 118-168 synapses (about 7-10x the PSI input)
applicability: specificity burden: any PSI-specific claim must exclude the majority partners
limitation: none
gate_relevance: quantifies the specificity burden for the stimulation controls

claim: MN5 axon diameter is unmeasured; the freeze records MN5 axonal length as NONE
applicability: geometry-dependent identifiability arguments cannot use an MN5 axon diameter
limitation: absence bounded by the evidence base
gate_relevance: blocks geometry-based identifiability claims

claim: The PSI->MN5 contacts lie in the PDMN peripheral nerve in the thorax; the contacts span about 50 um of nerve
applicability: the nerve span is not a soma-referenced path length
limitation: 50 um is a nerve span, not a soma-referenced biological path
gate_relevance: locates the measurement target; optical access to a thoracic motor nerve is a separate gap

claim: Electrode recordings from small insect processes are documented as impractical (Gouwens & Wilson 2009, their ~200 nm antennal-lobe processes)
direct_measurement: YES - access constraint documented in that preparation
applicability: a statement about their small processes, not a theorem about MN5's unmeasured axon
limitation: preparation-specific
gate_relevance: motivates the optical alternative; does not prove MN5 distal access impossible

claim: Somatic whole-cell patch of MN5 is established (in-situ thorax, Texas-red backfill)
applicability: provides the absolute mV reference and calibration anchor
limitation: soma only
gate_relevance: anchors the somatic reference of the design

claim: Optical access to a thoracic motor nerve has not been demonstrated in adult Drosophila in the evidence base (optic-lobe axon terminals behind a cuticle window have been imaged)
applicability: the imaging step's access path is undemonstrated for the PDMN
limitation: bounded by the searched evidence base
gate_relevance: blocks the optical configuration at the access step

claim: MN1-4 dual somatic patch is established (Hürkey et al. 2023, Nature 618:118); MN5 was not among them
direct_measurement: YES - dual somatic patch of MN1-4 pairs
applicability: supplies the MN1-4 comparison control; not an MN5 dual-site recording
limitation: MN5 not included
gate_relevance: supports the sibling-comparison control

claim: MN5 whole-cell capacitance is contested: 43 +/- 2 pF (Fayyazuddin 2006) versus 127 +/- 16 pF (Ryglewski & Duch 2009) - conflict C-01, about 2.95x, unresolved
direct_measurement: YES - two somatic measurements exist and disagree
applicability: the contest must not be resolved by choosing a value; Cm is not a transfer observable
limitation: two labs disagree about 2.95x; unresolved (C-01)
gate_relevance: not a transfer observable; preserved as contested

claim: Dalpha7 biological conductance remains NOT AUTHORIZED: no native Dalpha7 conductance, reversal, kinetics or density exists in the evidence base
applicability: the Dalpha7-specific component cannot be isolated before the total synaptic conductance is known
limitation: bounded by the evidence base
gate_relevance: GATE 2 stays closed

claim: PSI->MN5 postsynaptic spatial voltage transfer remains NOT AUTHORIZED: no MN5 non-somatic or dual-site voltage measurement exists (blocker B-4)
applicability: this audit designs an experiment; it performs none
limitation: bounded by the evidence base
gate_relevance: GATE 1 stays closed

claim: The minimum gate-opening experiment (DLMn-population GEVI access, anatomical MN5 identification, somatic whole-cell reference, >=2 process imaging sites, validated PSI/GF stimulation, GEVI calibration, optical artifact controls, EM/live registration if individual contacts are claimed) is a proposal
applicability: no element has been performed in MN5; it resolves B-4 only if executed successfully
limitation: requires PSI-specific activation, which is currently NOT ESTABLISHED
gate_relevance: the smallest credible configuration that could resolve B-4

claim: The anatomical identification strategy identifies the soma; distal targeting needs the missing EM->live registration (asymmetric access)
source: Fayyazuddin et al. 2006 plus project audit (research/)
direct_measurement: YES - soma identification; NO - distal identification
applicability: soma-referenced design is possible; contact-referenced design is not
limitation: none
gate_relevance: defines what the experiment can and cannot reference

claim: Direct MN5 somatic current injection is established (Fayyazuddin 2006; Ryglewski & Duch 2009) and probes somatofugal transfer - the reverse direction; reciprocity is not guaranteed in a cell with subthreshold-active conductances
applicability: serves as the direct-MN5 control; does not measure PSI->MN5 transfer
limitation: reverse direction; reciprocity not guaranteed
gate_relevance: control, not a measurement of the gate quantity

claim: PSI->MN5 is chemical (acetylcholine; conditional cha mutations - genetic inference) while PSI participates in the GFS gap-junction network (GF->PSI electrical, ShakB/innexin)
direct_measurement: YES - transmitter and coupling mode documented
applicability: an electrical-coupling confound assessment is mandatory; coupled contributions must be controlled, not assumed absent
limitation: receptor identity is genetic inference, not direct identification
gate_relevance: mandates the coupling-confound control

claim: A Dalpha7-independent negative control is appropriate only after the total synaptic conductance is known
applicability: the Dalpha7-specific component cannot be isolated before the total conductance is known
limitation: depends on B-6 resolution
gate_relevance: sequencing constraint on the control set

claim: The project's adopted passive parameters (specific membrane capacitance, axial resistivity, leak density) are literature-derived passive parameters carried in the freeze under conflict C-10; they are adopted model inputs, not MN5 measurements, and this audit neither uses nor introduces them
source: Ryglewski & Duch 2009 via Meseke et al. 2009 (as recorded in the project freeze)
direct_measurement: NO - adopted model input, not a measurement
applicability: adopted, not measured in MN5; contested (C-10); not used by this audit
limitation: adopted from generic insect-neuron defaults; internal-consistency failure flagged in the project audit
gate_relevance: none - the audit introduces no passive parameter
